tagline: A no-nonsense, open-source app for electric unicycles.
lead.1: Open source, no ads, no in-app tracking, no upselling, no subscriptions, no telemetry phoned home, no nonsense.
lead.2: Live telemetry, turn-by-turn navigation, a video recorder with on-screen telemetry overlay, a Wear OS dial, and a trip recorder. Modern, fast, all in one app.
lead.3: Free to build and sideload from GitHub. The store listing is just an easy way to get auto-updates and chip in. On an iPhone, join the TestFlight beta.
fc.wheels.title: Works with your wheel
fc.wheels.body: InMotion V14 and P6 verified. KingSong, Begode, Veteran (LeaperKim), NOSFET and more InMotion models are rider-tested, the rest of those families and Ninebot in preview. Help us add yours, or send a diagnostics recording if it acts up.
fc.modern.title: Modern & fast
fc.modern.body: A pure-black dashboard with almost no lag, built to be read in one glance at speed. Reorder the tiles, theme every color, and it adapts to portrait, bar-mount landscape, tablets and foldable cover screens.
fc.record.title: Record and compare
fc.record.body: Every ride is recorded with GPS and wheel telemetry, in a CSV format other EUC apps and tools can read. Open any trip for its graphs, or let Compare put two rides side by side.
fc.charging.title: Charging, cell by cell
fc.charging.body: A live charge curve with a prediction line you can scrub. On wheels with a smart BMS, a per-cell view shows cell voltages, pack imbalance and temperatures, so a weak cell shows up early.
fc.navigation.title: Navigation, offline too
fc.navigation.body: Multi-stop routes with turn-by-turn guidance. Bike routes prefer quiet streets, and a missed turn gets a new route in seconds. Download the areas you ride and the map, routes and turn cues keep working with no signal.
fc.devices.title: Watch and helmet
fc.devices.body: Your wheel's numbers off the phone: a Wear OS watch app, a Garmin watch or Edge data field, an Amazfit dial, and a MotoEye or any Android helmet HUD, also in Android Auto mode with the route.
fc.alarms.title: Alarms & voice
fc.alarms.body: Alarms and spoken reports for speed, battery and PWM, the number that says how close the wheel is to its limit, in your language. Ask for battery or speed by voice, or say horn, lights, lock.
fc.studio.title: Overlay Studio
fc.studio.body: Record video with your telemetry on screen, laid out your way. Export MP4 or a transparent overlay for another camera's footage. The same editor designs your MotoEye HUD and the Phone HUD overlay on Android.
fc.sensors.title: Buttons, radar, sensors
fc.sensors.body: Flic 2 buttons for horn, lights and lock. A Garmin Varia shows vehicles coming up behind you, with alarms on distance and closing speed. Bluetooth tire pressure caps and a RaceBox GPS feed the dashboard too.
fc.group.title: Group rides
fc.group.body: Share a ride with a link or a QR code and see friends live on the map, with trails. End-to-end encrypted, with a web page for watching without the app. Opt in to the EUC Stats leaderboard to see how your distance ranks worldwide.
fc.weather.title: Riding weather
fc.weather.body: A score for how the next hours look for riding, from rain, wind and gusts, cold, heat and night, weighted by how much you mind each one. Drag the curve to read any hour.
fc.private.title: Private, and yours to tune
fc.private.body: No analytics, no beacons, no in-app call-home. Rides stay on your device, with optional Dropbox backup to your own folder. An Advanced panel exposes the knobs behind every feature, each with a safe range and one-tap restore.
footer.sig: Built with stubbornness and no spreadsheets.

hud.a-helmet-display-that-mirrors-your: A helmet display that mirrors your phone over WiFi.
hud.four-ways-tried-in-this-order: Four ways, tried in this order.
hud.li.sideload-hud-version-apk-on-the: Sideload hud-<version>.apk on the HUD device. Works on MotoEye E6, generic tablets, spare phones.
hud.li.install-euc-planet-on-your-phone: Install EUC Planet on your phone from eucplanet.ried.no.
hud.li.turn-on-the-phone-s-hotspot: Turn on the phone's hotspot and connect the HUD to it, or put both on the same WiFi.
hud.li.on-the-phone-open-settings-integr: On the phone, open Settings → Integrations → Motoeye HUD and turn on Enable data link.
hud.p.that-is-the-whole-setup-the: That is the whole setup. The phone finds the HUD by itself.
hud.p.the-hud-calls-out-and-the: The HUD calls out and the phone hears it. The only one that survives a hotspot that blocks multicast.
hud.p.the-phone-browses-the-network-for: The phone browses the network for _eucplanet._tcp.local.
hud.p.where-the-hud-was-last-session: Where the HUD was last session.
hud.p.a-sweep-of-the-phone-s: A sweep of the phone's own network. It takes a few seconds.
hud.p.if-all-four-fail-turn-off: If all four fail, set Discovery mode to Fixed and type the IP the HUD shows on its splash screen. Keep both sides on matching versions.
